verdict.rationale: No first-party doc in the pack states per-model context windows or max output tokens. The only on-topic evidence is a community report citing specific figures (64K input, 8K output) for an earlier model, which suggests precise limits were published at some point. The pricing page is shown to carry per-model tables, but only for concurrency, not token limits. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of input/output token limits per model, coverage of current models (V4, V4.1 Flash, the vision model), thinking-mode output budgets, and independent confirmation that published limits match real behavior.
